hard_preconditions: all planned rows belong to DEV, TRAIN, or VAL
no planned or materialized workset directory belongs to a SEALED subject
workset contains no unplanned sequence directory

geometry_contract.depth: uint16 millimetre Z-depth converted to metres
geometry_contract.mask_selection: person mask is applied in depth coordinates before registration
geometry_contract.projection: OpenCV pinhole with released K and no distortion coefficients
geometry_contract.z_buffer: frontmost projected person depth within 5 mm per color pixel

automatic_usability_gate.cross_camera_nearest_surface_distance: descriptive only because cameras see different surfaces

torso_validity_definition.name: GEOMETRIC_BODY_CORE_PROXY_NOT_ANATOMY
torso_validity_definition.method: erode projected silhouette by 7x7 pixels and retain points in its central 20-80 percent x/y quantile box
torso_validity_definition.allowed_use: registration support QA and sample filtering
torso_validity_definition.forbidden_claim: anatomical torso or clinical back annotation

outputs.repository: protocol, executable code, compact final summary, and small contact-sheet evidence only

trainer_interface: cam008 is cached under prepare_observations Camera-A keys (rgb_a, bbox_a, K_a, R_a, T_a, points_a); cam009 uses the corresponding Camera-B keys.
cache_consumption_rule: The cache contains every planned candidate for auditability. A training loader may consume only rows whose manifest usable is true and visual_registration_review is PASS.
decision_rule: No training starts until automatic QA and all contact-sheet pages pass visual review for gross RGB-depth displacement.
